headline: Wema Bank Nine-Month Pre-Tax Profit Jumps 76.6% to N258.6B
summary: Nigeria's Wema Bank reported a 76.62% increase in pre-tax profit to N258.64 billion for the nine months ended September 30, up from N146.43 billion a year earlier, driven by strong interest income.
why: Wema Bank is a prominent Nigerian commercial lender, and its performance reflects how elevated policy rates are boosting net interest margins in the country's banking sector.
